parts:
Hello LAVAAN members

Discover how to apply advanced statistical techniques to your research using a powerful R package. Instrumental Variable Analysis Using lavaan in R led by Michael Zyphur (University of Queensland and Instats) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. This seminar introduces instrumental variable analysis and structural equation modeling (SEM) using the lavaan package in R. It covers estimating causal effects with observational data, mediation, bootstrapping, and Bayesian estimation for hypothesis testing. Researchers can apply these robust methods to analyze complex relationships, enhance causal inference in their own observational studies, and improve their practical data analytic skills within the lavaan framework.

Access this seminar online at your convenience and we'd appreciate you sharing this with colleagues and students!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
